paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc. is 2.61, with a 26.7% change versus the prior close and a -17.41% change over a window of 23 sessions. There were 6 new news articles in the last 24 hours.

Recent news headlines include reports of a 600-Megawatt capacity deal with a hyperscaler, Fermi America announcing the lease termination of TensorWave and new hyperscaler agreements, and plans to expand the Project Matador campus. Some sources also reported that Amazon is the previously unnamed customer for Project Matador, with a $200 million upfront prepayment and early construction commitments.

There have been various SEC filings, including 5 Form 4 and 7 Form 144 filings, as well as a 10-Q and 8-K filing on November 12, 2026. The 10-Q filing discloses the company's Q3 2026 financial and operational updates, while the 8-K filing discloses the company's financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026.
